title: 纸绘上方保护内角
description: 剪纸构成浅内角上方保护场景，完整绳路与制动姿态都明确。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: An original layered-paper illustration shows a fictional adult climbing a shallow indoor corner on an easy top-rope route. Positive footholds support a comfortable moderate stance, and large orange jugs sit on both wall faces. Use a wide composition showing the whole opaque-clothed climber and competent adult belayer. Both wear correctly fitted waist-and-leg-loop harnesses; the rope ties correctly through the climber's designated points, rises continuously to the overhead anchor, and returns to the belayer's device. The belayer watches attentively with the brake hand down on the brake strand. Include clear floor, readable rope routing, fiber texture, and believable anatomy. No free solo, extreme splits, lettering, or brands.
